payload.title: Tenant switch: bearer-based session re-mint endpoint (POST /api/tenant/switch)
payload.description:
frick-server has no way to switch the active tenant of an already-authenticated session. /auth/login accepts an optional tenant_id and mint_session(&tenant_id,...) exists, but mint_session is pub(crate) and there is no /api/tenant/switch (or /auth/tenant/switch) route. Consequences downstream (Zavro AQ-181): both the web (apps/web/lib/session.ts switchTenant POSTs ${HTTP_ENDPOINT}/api/tenant/switch) and iOS workspace switchers 404 — a user who belongs to multiple companies/tenants cannot re-scope reads to another tenant without re-entering a password (login is the only mint path). Verified against rev aebcfb5: POST /api/tenant/switch → HTTP 404.

Ask: add a built-in route (e.g. POST /api/tenant/switch or /auth/tenant/switch) that takes a valid bearer + a target tenant identifier, verifies the principal is permitted in that tenant (ensure_tenant_allowed already exists), and re-mints a session for it WITHOUT requiring the password — returning the same shape as /auth/login (sessionToken, tenantId, userId, deviceId, replicaId, expiresAt). Alternatively expose a public mint/re-issue API so app hosts can implement the route in their app_router. Today neither exists. Consumers waiting: Zavro web + iOS (AQ-181).
